mapper.select: SELECT b.board_idx, b.mem_idx, b.board_title, b.board_content, b.board_ip, b.board_tag, b.board_readhit, b.board_type_idx, b.board_regdate, b.board_moddate, b.board_is_deleted, b.board_deldate, m.mem_idx AS writer_mem_idx, m.mem_id AS writer_mem_id, m.mem_name AS writer_mem_name, m.mem_role_idx AS writer_mem_role_idx, bt.board_type_idx AS bt_idx, bt.board_type_code AS bt_code, bt.board_type_name AS bt_name, bt.board_can_comment AS bt_can_comment, bt.board_min_role AS bt_min_role FROM board b JOIN member m ON b.mem_idx = m.mem_idx JOIN board_type bt ON b.board_type_idx = bt.board_type_idx WHERE b.board_is_deleted = 'N' AND b.mem_idx = #{mem_idx} ORDER BY b.board_idx DESC

SELECT b.board_idx, b.mem_idx, b.board_title, b.board_content, b.board_ip, b.board_tag, b.board_readhit, b.board_type_idx, b.board_regdate, b.board_moddate, b.board_is_deleted, b.board_deldate, m.mem_idx AS writer_mem_idx, m.mem_id AS writer_mem_id, m.mem_name AS writer_mem_name, m.mem_role_idx AS writer_mem_role_idx, bt.board_type_idx AS bt_idx, bt.board_type_code AS bt_code, bt.board_type_name AS bt_name, bt.board_can_comment AS bt_can_comment, bt.board_min_role AS bt_min_role FROM board b JOIN member m ON b.mem_idx = m.mem_idx JOIN board_type bt ON b.board_type_idx = bt.board_type_idx WHERE b.board_idx = #{board_idx}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board ( board_idx, mem_idx, board_title, board_content, board_ip, board_tag, board_readhit, board_type_idx, board_regdate ) VALUES ( seq_board_idx.NEXTVAL, #{mem_idx}, #{board_title}, #{board_content}, #{board_ip}, #{board_tag}, 0, #{board_type_idx}, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE board SET board_title = #{board_title}, board_content = #{board_content}, board_tag = #{board_tag}, board_moddate = SYSDATE WHERE board_idx = #{board_idx}
UPDATE board SET board_is_deleted = 'Y', board_deldate = SYSDATE WHERE board_idx = #{board_idx}
mapper.select: SELECT board_type_idx FROM board_type WHERE UPPER(board_type_code) = UPPER(#{board_type_code})
